title: Measure of an independent product distribution
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set, and let $A_i$ be a finite measurable space for each $i\in I$, with every singleton measurable. For a probability mass function $p_i$ on each $A_i$, the measure associated with their independent product distribution equals the product measure of the associated coordinate measures.

measurability of every singleton in each coordinate set
a probability mass function on each coordinate set
